description: Open a project file (.dino) in Dinoctor, the same as File > Open, in place of the open project. Refuses if the open project has unsaved changes, unless discard: true (ask the person first, or save_project before). Returns the opened project's summary. For a new empty project use new_project; for a template use templates.

discard.description: true: drop unsaved changes in the open project. Only after the person agreed.

path.description: The project file's full path (see list_projects).

name: open_project
